title: Checksum Input
summary: Checks IBAN, card and ISBN check digits as you type and points to the swapped or doubled character, so money and orders don't go to a mistyped number.
description: Checks mod-97 (IBAN), Luhn (card) and ISBN check digits, IBAN country lengths and IFSC format as you type, then highlights the one swapped or doubled character that explains a failure instead of guessing a digit.
catches: IBAN mod-97 failures and wrong length for the country
Card numbers failing Luhn or with a wrong length for the brand
IFSC codes in the wrong format, with known bank codes read back
The swapped or doubled character that explains a failure
limits: A passing check digit means the number is well-formed, not that the account, card or book exists
IFSC has no check digit: only format and a few bank codes are checked
The IBAN length table needs updating when countries join the registry
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and aria-describedby to an aria-live="polite" status
Fix returns focus to the input
Grouped read-back is aria-hidden; status text carries the result
server: Validate the account or card with the bank or payment processor before moving money.
stops: Money sent to a mistyped account
